program.name: Inner Thigh Supersets
program.subject: Hips & adductors
program.blurb: Inner thighs every day in supersets, with the glutes one day and the hip flexors the next.
program.about: The inner thighs every day, in supersets with the muscles around them. One day pairs each adductor move with a glute move, bridges, clamshells and hip thrusts; the other pairs it with hip-flexor work. Strong, supple adductors protect the groin and make every squat and lunge steadier. Abs finish every session; Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
